# Module Reference {#sec-appendix-modules}

A one-line description of every application module. Logic modules
(`app/logic/`) are Shiny-free; view modules (`app/view/`) are Shiny modules with
`ui`/`server` (@sec-arch-modules).

## `app/logic` — application logic

| Module | Purpose | Chapter |
|---|---|---|
| `app_meta.R` | Single source of the application version (`APP_VERSION`) | @sec-architecture |
| `paths.R` | Local-share directory and `state.json` loading | @sec-install |
| `logging.R` | Session log sink; structured event logging | @sec-install |
| `db_connect.R` | The one connection opener; arms the busy timeout | @sec-database |
| `db_events.R` | Per-domain revision bus (writers bump, readers depend) | @sec-architecture |
| `db_store.R` | The single shared reactive read of the `metadata` table | @sec-architecture |
| `database_functions.R` | Schema migration, metadata sync, MLST/AMR pivots, deletes | @sec-database |
| `db_sources.R` | Stable source labels for imported peers (`phylotrace_sources`) | @sec-tech-interop |
| `provenance.R` | Per-isolate `typing_provenance` row | @sec-tech-typing |
| `genome_hash.R` | Assembly content digest; duplicate classification | @sec-tech-typing |
| `pymlst.R` | pyMLST toolchain wrapper (download, type, parse, store) | @sec-tech-typing |
| `mlst_repo.R` | Deterministic classical-MLST scheme resolution | @sec-tech-typing |
| `amr.R` | AMR screening via abritamr/AMRFinderPlus; two AMR tables | @sec-tech-amr |
| `scheme_browser.R` | Species metadata, scheme identity, download orchestration | @sec-tech-schemes |
| `schemes.R` | Catalogue of supported schemes | @sec-tech-schemes |
| `profile_io.R` | Read/write cgMLST profile tables; export bundles | @sec-tech-interop |
| `db_compat.R` | Read-only compatibility gate for a merge | @sec-tech-interop |
| `db_import.R` | Content-mapped merge on a copy; atomic swap; backups | @sec-tech-interop |
| `db_export.R` | Fresh-built subset export | @sec-tech-interop |
| `db_staging.R` | `imported_*` staging for distance-only peer profiles | @sec-tech-interop |
| `custom_fields.R` | User-defined typed variables (`phylotrace_custom_*`) | @sec-tech-browser |
| `field_types.R` | Column type lookup (fixed/derived/custom) | @sec-tech-browser |
| `field_profile.R` | Column cardinality/coverage profiling for mapping | @sec-tech-visualization |

| `phylo.R` | Distance matrix, MST graph, NJ/UPGMA trees | @sec-tech-engines-mst, @sec-tech-engines-tree |

| `tree_plot.R` | Tree rendering (layout, axis, annotation) → ggtree | @sec-tech-engines-tree |
| `epi_plot.R` | Epidemic-curve binning and construction | @sec-tech-engines-epi |
| `amr_plot.R` | AMR matrix reshaping and heatmap/bar building | @sec-tech-engines-amr |
| `mapping_engine.R` | Picks aesthetic + palette from a variable's profile | @sec-tech-visualization |
| `viz_helpers.R` | Shared namespace-agnostic UI helpers; reset checklist | @sec-tech-visualization |
| `viz_export.R` | Shared plot export (ggplot re-render vs widget capture) | @sec-tech-visualization |
| `functions.R` | Small shared UI helpers (`sidebar_menu`, `stat_tile`, …) | @sec-architecture |

## Module dependency graph

The `box::use` graph fans out from `main.R` to the six top-level view modules
(@fig-module-tree), each pulling the `app/logic` modules it needs. The
load-bearing shared logic modules — imported by many views — are
`db_connect`, `db_events`, `db_store`, `database_functions`, `field_*`,
`phylo`, `viz_helpers`, `viz_export` and `functions`. The `logic`→`logic`
edges form a shallow tree (for example
`phylo.R` uses `db_connect` and `db_staging`; `db_import` uses `db_compat`,
`custom_fields`, `profile_io`), with no `view` module imported by a `logic`
module — the dependency direction is always view → logic.
